title: IdpOidcConfig
description: OIDC configuration. Some fields are computed by REAP and marked readOnly.

issuer.description: OP Issuer URL (/.well-known/openid-configuration is used for discovery).

clientId.description: OAuth2 client_id registered at the IdP.

clientSecretId.description: Reference to a Secret containing client_secret. The secret value is never returned here.

tokenAuthMethod.description: Client authentication at the token endpoint.

redirectUris.description: Callback URLs that must be registered at the IdP; computed by REAP.

scopes.description: OIDC scopes to request (e.g., openid, email, profile, groups).

enforcePkce.description: Require PKCE on authorization code flow.

groupsClaimPath.description: JSON pointer or dotted path to the claim providing groups.

rolesClaimPath.description: Optional path to a custom roles claim.

clockSkewSeconds.description: Allowed clock skew when validating tokens.
